producer_report.summary:
Root cause: athena.toml and its parser (crates/athena-data, strict on unknown fields) are changed separately. Nothing connected a new config section to the schema that must accept it before plan time, so jobs 20261016-071202-q0xy, 20261016-185517-qcrz and 20261016-200605-xh54 died at admission or landing.

The fix is a plan-time rule on the same shared predicate admission and the gate already use.
- **Gate:** `athena_gate::config_edits_without_schema` returns the non-deleted config or defaults files in a change when `defers_to_schema_test` is false, so it shares `SCHEMA_DIR`.
- **Plan:** `plan::schema_reference_problem` calls it. `PlanEntry` gets a `schema_problem` field, `missing()` reports it as `MISSING_SCHEMA`, and `Plan::build` refuses the entry. The refusal names `crates/athena-data/src/config.rs` or `defaults.rs` and keeps the code-reference detail when both problems apply.
- **Reading:** `reading::plan_entry` computes it from the reading's deliverables (deleted ones marked) for read requests only.
- **Tests:** a plan unit test, an end-to-end reading test, a gate test, and an admission test that runs real admission against a temporary repo. The admission test shows the plan rule, `defers_to_schema_test` and admission's configuration violation agree on the same inputs.
- **Changelog:** one new entry.

Because plan time cannot see whether an edit adds a section, any config edit must list a schema-directory path.

I ran fmt, clippy and the policy scan (all clean), plus the athena-core, athena-gate, athena-data and xtask tests, which all passed. I ran the full `cargo test --locked` once but could not read its output, so I did not rerun it.

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-core -p athena-gate -- schema config_edits agree
checks_run.note: the 3 new tests plus deferral tests

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked --quiet -p athena-core -p athena-gate -p athena-data -p xtask --lib --tests
checks_run.note: 544 passed in athena-core, 119 in athena-gate, plus data and xtask
full suite ran once; output was too large and saved outside the working directory, which I could not read. Not rerun. The crates above were rerun separately.

criteria_check.criterion: The change description names the root cause: config and parser change separately, and nothing connects a new athena.toml section to the schema that must accept it before plan time. It cites jobs 20261016-071202-q0xy, 20261016-185517-qcrz and 20261016-200605-xh54.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md entry and the doc comment on `schema_reference_problem` in crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs both state the root cause and cite the three jobs.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core (run with `cargo test -p athena-core`) shows that a plan or change which modifies athena.toml without any crates/athena-data/ path is flagged with a message that names the schema file to change. The same test shows that a change that also modifies crates/athena-data/src/config.rs is accepted. The test fails on the base commit and passes with the change.
criteria_check.evidence: New tests plan::tests::a_config_edit_without_the_schema_is_refused_and_with_it_accepted and reading::tests::a_reading_that_edits_configuration_without_the_schema_is_refused_at_plan_time pass. They cover config alone, the wrong crate, a deleted schema, and defaults.toml. They check the message names crates/athena-data/src/config.rs or defaults.rs, and that config plus the schema path is accepted. On the base commit `schema_reference_problem`, `MISSING_SCHEMA` and the `schema_problem` field do not exist, so they cannot compile. I did not run them on the base.

criteria_check.criterion: The plan-time rule calls `athena_gate::defers_to_schema_test`/SCHEMA_DIR rather than duplicating the path, and a test confirms that the gate, admission and the plan rule agree on the same inputs (`cargo test`).
criteria_check.evidence: `schema_reference_problem` calls `athena_gate::config_edits_without_schema`, which calls `defers_to_schema_test`; the message uses `athena_gate::SCHEMA_DIR`. The agreement test is admission::tests::plan_admission_and_the_gate_agree_on_when_the_schema_judges_a_config_edit. It runs real admission against a temporary repo and checks it against the plan rule and `defers_to_schema_test`. content::tests::config_edits_without_schema_is_the_other_side_of_the_deferral covers the gate side. Both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing gate and admission tests (unknown-field refusal in content.rs, deferral tests) and crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs still pass under `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: I reran `cargo test --locked --quiet -p athena-core -p athena-gate -p athena-data -p xtask --lib --tests`; every result was ok (athena-core 544 passed, 1 ignored; athena-gate 119 passed; no failures). That run includes the athena-data tests, repo_config.rs among them. I never read the full `cargo test --locked` output.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt --check and clippy -D warnings clean, and the crate test runs above passed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new check. No changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or .github/workflows.
criteria_check.evidence: New entry at the top of the Unreleased Fixed section in CHANGELOG.md. I edited no athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file.

open_issues: The rule is deliberately narrow. A reading that only changes a value in athena.toml, with no new section, is also refused unless it lists a crates/athena-data/ path. The plan cannot tell the two apart. The refusal message says to list the schema file or drop the config edit.
Admission's own configuration loop was not refactored onto `config_edits_without_schema`. It already uses `defers_to_schema_test`, and the agreement test pins the two together.
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG edit failed because its anchor matched 12 places. I re-anchored on the next entry's text.
I ran the full `cargo test --locked` once but could not read its saved output, so I reran the likely-affected crates in quiet mode instead.
learnings: Plan-time checks live in plan.rs. They are computed in `reading::plan_entry`, stored on `PlanEntry`, and reported by `PlanEntry::missing()`, which makes `Plan::build` refuse the entry.
`PlanEntry` is built with `..PlanEntry::bare` everywhere, so adding a field to it is cheap.
`Refusal::lacking_because` takes a single detail, so `Plan::build` now joins `code_problem` and `schema_problem` with `; `.
The existing `check_governance_coverage` in reading.rs covers the opposite direction (a config.rs deliverable needs athena.toml). The new rule covers a config edit without a schema path.
desires: A way to read saved tool output inside the working directory, so a large full-suite result can be inspected.
